name: Ikenai Hitozuma-tachi ~Doushitemo Gaman Dekinakute~
original_name: イケない人妻たち ～どうしても我慢できなくて～
source: When Kazuma goes to college he learns that he lives near 3 beautiful women. All of who want to cheat on their husbands.
